### Speed to lead decides who wins

Whoever gets back first usually gets the job. Every hour a new enquiry sits unanswered is an hour it cools off — and enquiries do not only arrive between nine and five. One lands at 9pm, another on a Saturday, another in the middle of a job you cannot walk away from. By the time somebody has a minute, the person has messaged two competitors and had an answer from one of them.
